description: Add real query-string canonicalization (sorted by key, stable for duplicates) to a no-op passthrough
prompts: urlutil.js's canonicalizeQuery(url) is a no-op - it just returns the URL unchanged. Implement it for real using node's URL/URLSearchParams: sort the query-string parameters by KEY only (not by value), keeping the RELATIVE order of parameters that share the same key unchanged (a stable sort), and rebuild the URL with the sorted query string. Scheme, host, path, and hash (fragment) must be left exactly as they were.
name: add_js_url_query_canonicalization
